issues.detail: The Hebrew has 'זְבֻל' (Zebul), but the Chinese renders it as '撒拔' (Saba), which is a different name. The correct transliteration should be '西布勒' or similar.

The Hebrew 'בֶן יְרֻבַּעַל' means 'son of Jerubbaal' (i.e., Gideon), but the Chinese says '耶路巴設的兒子' (son of Jerubbesheth), which is a different name. The Hebrew has 'יְרֻבַּעַל' (Jerubbaal), not 'יְרֻבֶּשֶׁת' (Jerubbesheth).
